sermon.title: Job responds to God - September 3, 2023
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: The final message in the Job series shows how Job responded when God spoke from the whirlwind: he acknowledged God can do everything, admitted he spoke what he didn’t understand, heard God, and repented in dust and ashes. When Job prayed for his friends, God restored him double; we too must confess, hate evil, forgive and change our behavior.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The service opens with worship (lyrics as captioned); the message begins at about 26:01. He cites “Proverbs 8:13” for the fear of the Lord is to hate evil, and “Luke 11:52” for woes Jesus spoke to the Pharisees (Matthew 23).

scriptures.text_nkjv: The wilderness and the wasteland shall be glad for them, And the desert shall rejoice and blossom as the rose;

faqs.question: Does he remember the lying spirit story?
faqs.answer: He mentions it and says he doesn’t remember all of it.

faqs.question: What is his police officer example?
faqs.answer: Lying through your teeth that you didn’t do nothing; you can’t do that with God.

faqs.question: What was Job’s condition when he acknowledged God?
faqs.answer: He had boils, had lost all his wealth, and was in pain.

faqs.question: What happened when he witnessed as a young man?
faqs.answer: He and a friend talked with a girl and started praying the sinner’s prayer when they were young and didn’t know what they were doing.

faqs.question: What is his example of admitting wrong?
faqs.answer: I was yelling at you this morning and that was wrong, honey, I’m sorry.

faqs.question: Will God cleanse all sin?
faqs.answer: He says He will cleanse from all unrighteousness, even the unpardonable sin.

faqs.question: What keeps us from accessing God?
faqs.answer: Our flesh and desires; I don’t got time for God.

faqs.question: What hearing do we need to test?
faqs.answer: Not the natural ear, like his daughter’s hearing test, but the spiritual ear.

faqs.question: What is better than an apology?
faqs.answer: Someone who slapped you and doesn’t do it again; changing your behavior.

faqs.question: Who was prayed for at the close?
faqs.answer: Miss Woods, that God would open her ears, heart and eyes.
